summary: Cited the two-voter vote probe (receipt b999288258be402cb987482ced5256c1) in the configuration-recovery account, bounding the authority claim from the other side. The receipt records the same recovered node tracking no configuration (event 19: latest_config_index 0 with no members, group size two) and, when its peer is restarted so that it must campaign, the peer is elected - in a two-voter group a majority is both members, so that leadership required the defective node's vote - while the defective node again showed zero candidate samples (event 20, comparison holds). The account now states explicitly that the defect removes the node as a candidate, not as a voter: it can still support a peer's candidacy, and its harm is that it cannot itself be the source of a new leader. A counterevidence item records that any consequence assuming the node is absent from every future majority would overstate the effect. The question now cites seven receipts with its conclusion and other boundaries unchanged; the remaining limitations are the structural harness ones plus the durable-snapshot propagation path, which the remaining allocation cannot complete with a citation.
